endorsements.quote: Prospectively, the model(s) would need to be tested on ‘unseen’ clinical data to simulate real-world usage.

unlisted_practices: Compare AI model predictions with actual clinical outcomes to determine accuracy, sensitivity and specificity.
Base AI risk prediction algorithms on high-quality data and minimise biases before using them to inform population-wide screening programmes.
Weigh the potential benefits of AI against drawbacks such as data sharing, ethics and possible biases before introducing AI-driven clinical support tools in population screening programmes.
Carefully evaluate the potential application of clinical decision support systems to type 1 diabetes screening.
Evaluate nationwide screening initiatives integrated into the healthcare system for their medical, economic and psychological consequences.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective from researchers and clinicians discussing the potential and implementation considerations of using AI for early screening of type 1 diabetes.
